1. Create new repository (https://console.cloud.google.com/artifacts)
2. Clone repo using the cloud terminal (upper right hand corner terminal icon). `git clone -b google-cloud-batch https://github.com/MOshima-PIFSC/NSASS-HTC-HPC-Computing.git`
3. Build Docker file 

```
    cd NSASS-HTC-HPC-Computing
    gcloud builds submit \
  -t us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/batch-project-test/containers/nsass-lm-array:v1 .
```
